text:
Alina (PM): Quick async — small check on the Q3 OKR milestone for model-routing. TL;DR: API surface and fallback logic shipped; canary rolled to staging 5% but we hit a regression on quantized path causing tail latency spikes. Need owners + next steps.

Matt (Eng): I started a quick triage. 95th/99th spikes tied to KV cache warmup failures on long sequences, looks like cache misses + one-off big-batch path. Attaching short log excerpt.

Jordan (Eng-Platform): I can flip the routing to prefer the legacy routing for affected prefixes while we investigate. That requires a canary policy change (reduce to 2% or pause). Need product sign-off.

Sasha (Product Ops): Fine to drop to 2% and pause expansion. prioritize avoiding customer-facing degradation. :thumbsup: If safer, pause outbound to Dedicated for now.

Kevin (Eng Runtime): Found a config bug in the per-model batch override that causes an occasional oversized batch on quantized kernels. Sending a patch PR now. Snippet of fix:```yaml
model_routes:
  - name: model-routing-v2
    batch_override: 64  # was unintentionally 512 for quantized path
```
PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/4286 (draft -> ready)

Matt (Eng): CR #4286 needs one more approval (runtime/infra). Also I pushed a small hotfix branch `fix/kv-warmup` with extra logging. Can someone approve so I can run canary again?

Chris (Design): UI side change for rollout widget is non-blocking, I left a tiny comment on the PR. Not blocking the canary. :white_check_mark:

Alina (PM): Owners: Kevin -> runtime patch + PR follow-up, Matt -> logs + hotfix canary, Jordan -> routing policy rollback if needed, Sasha -> business decision on ramp/pausing Dedicated. Timeline: aim to close this by EOD tomorrow. Please update the PR and add ETA in the PR description.

Matt (Eng): tagging for approvals: @Kevin (done) @Jordan (PTAL) @Chris (design ack) — will rerun canary once PR is merged and batch_override fixed.

Jordan (Eng-Platform): I'll prepare the quick rollback policy and a temporary routing rule: `if seq_len > 2048 and quantized == true -> route: legacy` so we avoid the hit in prod. Will post the rollout plan here before making changes.

Sasha (Product Ops): Confirmed — pause Dedicated traffic if we see >2% error or >200ms tail increase. I'll monitor analytics and call for a rollback if thresholds crossed.

deploy-bot: canary status update — model-routing-v2 canary paused at 5% (staging). Commit: a1b2c3d. No auto-rollout. Jobs: build/4286, e2e/quick, perf/kv-warmup.

Alina (PM): Good. Quick ask: everyone add a 1-line status to the PRs and ping this thread when you merge. I'll capture shipped/slipped in the OKR doc after closure. Thanks all. :sparkles:
